title: FloodWorld
description: Replaces all air with water during chunk generation.
body:
![title-full](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1430e7893f9111f14579d74fbdea2533586c39e9.png)

![asd](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e683cb8b4a3270a1cebdd8498187affb89c5cff1.png)
## Features
FloodWorld is a Fabric mod that replaces all air with water during chunk generation.

- Water is by default placed directly during chunk generation, and only then. Air created after a chunk is generated is preserved even if the chunk is reloaded.
- Fully configurable (ModMenu + Cloth Config)
- Cave flooding by default
- Server compatible, Works on multiplayer servers. Clients do not need the mod installed.
  
![asd](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e683cb8b4a3270a1cebdd8498187affb89c5cff1.png)
## Configuration
Requires ModMenu and Cloth Config for in-game configuration

Replace Air - Fills regular air blocks with water

Replace Cave Air -Fills cave air blocks with water

Max Water Height - The Y level below which air becomes water

Native Flooding - Places water during generation (fast) vs post-processing tick queue (compatible)

![asd](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e683cb8b4a3270a1cebdd8498187affb89c5cff1.png)
## Dependencies
Required:

- Fabric Loader
- Fabric API

Optional (for config screen):

- ModMenu
- Cloth Config

![asd](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e683cb8b4a3270a1cebdd8498187affb89c5cff1.png)
![compatibility](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/66d4bd07d5e30114cdcc67dc604d7be385221189_0.webp)

Minecraft 1.21.x (Fabric)
Should work on fabric multiplayer servers,
server-side only, no client installation required

![asd](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e683cb8b4a3270a1cebdd8498187affb89c5cff1.png)
![Notes](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/51740110ca47d2c31a191611dac9e14be8a06ea7.png)

Settings only apply to newly generated chunks. Existing chunks will not be retroactively flooded or un-flooded.
On first world creation there may be a brief loading screen delay while Minecraft locates a valid spawn point above the waterline.
Changing the Native Flooding setting requires a world restart to take effect on new chunks.
